sources: Microsoft Learn: NewsAndInterests Policy CSP, AllowNewsAndInterests (0 = not allowed), group policy 'Allow widgets' under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh (Windows 11).
The description only promises that widgets are turned off, not a speed gain.

Host 2026-10-24, build 26200: as administrator, Windows creates the key SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh but refuses the value AllowNewsAndInterests (access denied), also refuses deleting the key again; therefore only up to build 26199 (like UI-005, which Windows blocks from 26200 too).
